attr.title: FORM
attr.desc: An experimental audiovisual sculpture. Pure maths: a body of points, a drone and tuned strikes, all generated in real time and shaped by the controls. A nod to the demoscene and to 90s and 00s drone and IDM. Built for handhelds with two analogue sticks that click for L3 and R3, plus L1, R1, L2 and R2.
